description:
Headquarters: Massachusetts Remote

 Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Solutions Engineer, US Enterprise - East Coast

 Get to know Okta

 Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

 Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

 The Solutions Engineering Team

 We believe Solutions Engineers at Okta are involved in all stages of the customer’s digital transformation. Solutions Engineers are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers virtually and in-person. We are looking for great teammates who can build and deliver sales presentations and customized product demonstrations to help educate Okta’s Customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on best practices during their cloud security technology journey. We believe Okta’s Solutions Engineers empathize with Customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed, clarifying questions while presenting solutions that specifically address those needs. Okta Solution Engineers have the rare combination of technical acumen and business insight; in a career where you can utilize both. As a Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will further develop each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on the value they will gain by using Okta’s Identity Platform.
 The Solutions Engineer Opportunity

 Reporting to the Senior Manager Solutions Engineering, Okta the Solutions Engineer is a functional business consultant, with a passion for technology and the advanced ability to develop, position and demonstrate product-specific solutions during sales cycles, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

 What you’ll be doing

• Work alongside the sales team as the technical and domain expert of a customer-facing sales team to help Customers understand the value of Okta’s solutions

• Understand customer challenges and business issues and provide product demonstrations to align our solutions with customer needs

• Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, partners and Okta colleagues

• Plan and deliver Proof Of Concepts for customers who have more complex use cases, collaborating with other Okta engineering teams as needed

• Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value

• Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solutions Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

• Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

• At times, be asked to learn and lead your team as a subject matter expert (SME) with various product solutions and/or competitive knowledge

 What you’ll bring to the role

• 5+ years pre-sales engineering experience and solution selling.

• A passion to serve the Customer, demonstrated in a customer-facing role, such as presales or professional services, but ideally in a pre-sales capacity.

• An ability to quickly communicate complex ideas around a technical topic, ideally on the fly, using a whiteboard.

• Deployed apps in cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, etc.

• Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (eg. OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP)

• Experience working with REST APIs and SDKs

• Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: web (JavaScript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python) development, scripting (Bash, Powershell, Perl)

• An understanding of core security concerns within a typical application. (password hashing, SSL/TLS, encryption at rest, XSS, XSRF)

• You're an exceptional communicator, adept at simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, including highly skilled experts in large group settings.

• A confident and articulate presenter, you excel at sharing knowledge and insights with experienced technical professionals and large expert audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical information to highly skilled and experienced audiences, whether one-on-one or in large presentations.

• Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterparts to guide execution excellence

• Diagramming experience for user journey flows, complex architecture diagrams, etc.

• Typically 25% travel.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or equivalent experience

 You ideally have

• Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions in enterprise environments.

• Deep understanding of the challenges and best practices associated with securing privileged accounts, including just-in-time (JIT) access, session recording, credential vaulting, and secrets management.

• Practical experience managing Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, and Federation services.

• Proficiency in UNIX/Linux, database security, network security, scripting, and DevOps practices preferred.

• Relevant experience with enterprise applications, security management, systems management, identity management, and/or policy management solutions, particularly in the areas of Identity and Privileged Access

 Pinterest is seeking a Manager II, Engineering to lead our Kubernetes Platform team. The team builds and operates the infrastructure and tooling that help engineers run reliable, scalable services on Kubernetes.

 You will lead engineers working on production systems that need to be dependable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for customers to use. You will work with partner teams across Pinterest to improve the platform, reduce operational friction, and make sound decisions when reliability, speed, cost, and security pull in different directions.

 What you’ll do:

• Lead a team of engineers responsible for Kubernetes platform infrastructure and the systems that support it.

• Establish the team’s 12-month strategy, roadmap, and success measures.

• Improve the reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency of the platform.

• Drive architecture and technical decisions, including in areas that are new to you. Build context quickly, involve the right experts, and make decisions when the team needs direction.

• Partner with engineering, product, finance, security, and cloud-provider teams on shared technical and operational challenges.

• Recruit, coach, and develop engineers; empower senior technical leaders; and sustain an inclusive, accountable team.

• Use AI to accelerate analysis, investigations, documentation, and repeatable workflows while applying judgment and verification to ensure quality.

 What we’re looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Minimum 3 years of experience managing engineering teams in infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, cloud systems, distributed systems, or similar technical areas.

• Experience managing and developing teams that build or operate large-scale cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, shared compute platforms, or other production systems.

• Experience setting a multi-quarter technical strategy and delivering through senior engineers.

• Technical experience in public cloud, highly available distributed systems, Kubernetes or shared-compute platforms, and production operations.

• A strong reliability mindset and experience leading teams responsible for the operational quality of production systems.

• Experience leading cross-functional infrastructure programs and communicating reliability, security, cost, capacity, and delivery tradeoffs to partner teams.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in day-to-day work.

• Strong record of evaluating AI-assisted work through testing, source checking, data validation, or peer review.

• High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI, and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.

• Experience managing a Production Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similarly production-focused infrastructure team.

• Experience with managed Kubernetes services, especially Amazon EKS or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).

• Experience operating a large Kubernetes fleet or multi-tenant compute platform.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, Kubernetes lifecycle management, observability, networking, or production upgrades.

title: Customer Success Executive (APAC & Middle East)
description:
Headquarters: Singapore, Singapore

 URL: https://alliants.com

Our hotel partners across Asia are mid-shift while our UK team sleeps — and we're looking for a Customer Success Associate to be the in-region contact who picks up their questions and issues in their own time zone.

 The role at a glance • Title: Customer Success Associate
• Location: Remote, based in Singapore (nearby APAC time zones considered), working mostly APAC hours
• Compensation: £35,000 – £37,000 per year
• Contract: 2-year contract
• Team: Customer Success (APAC & Middle East pod), reporting to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager

This is an associate-level customer success role on our APAC & Middle East team, and it's built around two things.

 • You'll be our our in-region first response. When a property hits a problem overnight UK time, you pick it up, work with the hotel team and our in-region support, and hand the UK team a clear head start — rather than the hotel waiting for London to wake up.
• You'll own the day-to-day relationship with our standard properties across a region of more than 120 hotels and 13 brands. That means support follow-through, re-onboarding properties that need it, and making sure every hotel gets real value from our platform.

Enterprise and Growth accounts sit with the Enterprise Customer Success Manager. You'll shadow and support that work as you learn, and take on more over time; this role is the in-region contact for standard properties.

 Role Focus & Operating Context
You'll communicate with hoteliers the way great hoteliers talk to their guests. Every message is written by you, with care. You'll work mostly in APAC hours, with some overlap into UK afternoons — more at the start. You'll sit in a small regional pod alongside Product Solutions, Support and Sales, with property teams from front office to GM as your day-to-day contacts.

 What you'll work on and own • The overnight queue — what happens when a property's guest messaging stops at 2am in London and you're the one awake
• Standard property relationships — day-to-day contact with front office, guest relations, operations and GMs
• Re-onboarding — showing property teams how the platform works, how to configure it and how to escalate
• Adoption — playbooks rolled out property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites
• The regional read-out — a usage, adoption and support-trends dashboard reviewed monthly
• Clean records — accurate Salesforce data and product feedback routed to the right team

 What you'll bring
 • Guest-facing experience in luxury hotel operations — front office, guest relations, guest experience or rooms division
• Written and spoken English to luxury-hotel standard — you know how to write to a GM
• A real understanding of how a property runs, shift to shift
• Ownership — you take a problem from first message to resolution without being chased
• Comfort with simple reporting and data (spreadsheets, PMS or CRM reports)
• Confidence explaining technology to non-technical hotel teams
• Based in Singapore or a nearby APAC time zone, and able to contract with Alliants from there
• Availability to work mostly APAC hours, with some flexibility into UK afternoons
 Nice to have
 • Customer success, onboarding or account support experience at a hospitality technology company
• Hands-on use of Salesforce, Jira or Intercom
• Experience running training for hotel teams
• A regional language such as Mandarin, Arabic, Japanese, Bahasa or Thai
 To thrive in this role, you'll be someone who:
 • Asks questions before jumping to a fix, and finds the real problem
• Treats every hotelier like a valued guest
• Uses usage data and ticket trends, not anecdote, to decide where to focus
• Works confidently on your own and knows when to escalate
• Adapts naturally across the cultures of APAC and the Middle East
• Wants to understand how the technology works underneath

 • You'll be the named, same-time-zone contact for standard properties across APAC and the Middle East.
• You'll pick up issues raised outside UK hours, work them with the property and in-region support, and hand the UK a clear head start.
• You'll own tickets from standard properties alongside Support, escalating to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager when needed.
• You'll re-onboard properties where gaps remain after deployment, so teams use the platform with confidence.
• You'll roll out adoption playbooks property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites, and build localised guides and training.
• You'll shadow enterprise calls and pick up location-level work on Enterprise accounts as you learn.
• You'll track usage, adoption and support trends in a regional dashboard, with a monthly read-out.
• You'll flag at-risk properties early, so we keep the hotels we have.
• You'll keep Salesforce accurate for every property you support.
• You'll route product feedback and requests through Product Solutions intake.

 Who is Alliants and what do we do?
Alliants, established in 2009, is dedicated to producing customer engagement technologies and services that pave the way for a more human, sustainable, and promising future for hospitality.

At Alliants, we are all in for our people and our industry.

 What's in it for you?
We know we all work better in an autonomous, collaborative, diverse and equitable space. To support you in becoming the best version of yourself, we offer:
 • Remote, in region: work remotely from Singapore, mostly in APAC hours
• Flexible hours: once you're settled in, a late day for the UK is balanced by a later start the next day
• Time to learn: around six months to learn the platform, including shadowing enterprise calls
• A regional team: work alongside our APAC & Middle East Customer Success and Product Solutions colleagues
• A warm welcome: to celebrate you joining Alliants, we'll plant a Great Oak tree in your honour

Alliants celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alliants-limited-customer-success-executive-apac-middle-east

title: Actuary, UK
description:
We’re looking for a technically savvy Pricing Actuary to join the UK team and support pricing adequacy, accuracy, and competitiveness of our European products. You will contribute your actuarial expertise as part of an interdisciplinary team that includes data scientists, insurance Product and Underwriting professionals. Working in collaboration, you’ll help develop and implement new pricing capabilities that blend actuarial approaches with predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

In this role you’ll

  • Help shape our UK pricing strategy, balancing profitable growth, competitive prices and great customer outcomes.

  • Recommend pricing and underwriting actions based on ongoing performance monitoring and competitive analysis

  • Build a deep understanding of competitor pricing and our position on price comparison websites, using those insights to improve how we price.

  • Own pricing changes from idea to launch, testing their impact and tracking what happens once they’re live.

  • Partner with Data Science, Product and Underwriting to bring together predictive models, customer behaviour and commercial insight.

  • Bring your UK insurance expertise to our global team, sharing knowledge and challenging assumptions to help us make better decisions.

  • Help build a faster, smarter pricing engine through automation, experimentation and thoughtful use of AI.

  • Further your actuarial education through industry research and stay on top of changing regulatory requirements

What you’ll need

  • 5-7 years of UK personal lines pricing experience, including hands-on commercial or street pricing.

  • Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA)

  • A strong understanding of how the UK insurance market works, with practical experience of price comparison websites, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.

  • A track record of turning analysis into pricing changes that deliver measurable results.

  • Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with confidence exploring data independently and checking that your conclusions hold up.

  • Commercial judgement and curiosity: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions and connect the numbers to what’s happening in the market.

  • Clear communication skills and enthusiasm for sharing your UK market knowledge with colleagues across the business.

  • Working knowledge of UK pricing/insurance regulations

  • UK home pricing experience is a strong plus, as is experience with demand modelling or optimisation.

  • Enthusiasm for learning and working with AI, and exploring how it can improve the way we price and work.Ability to work from our London office.

  • Master’s degree in mathematics / econometrics / actuarial science / related field preferred

title: Product Manager - Security
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation.

Your responsibilities will include:

1. Product Management

  • Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products.
  • Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes.
  • Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything.

2. Customer-facing communications

  • Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status.
  • In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO.
  • Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements.

3. Competitive analysis and market research

  • Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications.
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market.
  • Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards).

4. Certification and audit support, service ownership

  • Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements.
  • Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform.
  • Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives.

5. Cross-functional collaboration

  • Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging.
  • Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports).
  • Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally.

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives.
  • Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value.
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences).
  • Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams.
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions.
  • Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day.

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Third Party Risk Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

⭐️ Our Third Party & Outsourcing Risk Management Team

We are a high-performing Global team focused on delivering pragmatic Third Party Risk Management (‘TPRM’) that protects Monzo and our customers globally. As Monzo expands across new markets and scales its product range, the operational footprint is growing fast, and the operating environment is becoming more complex.

We’re looking for a Senior Third Party Risk Manager to help shape and deliver our approach. As well as ensuring Monzo’s TPRM has well defined controls, processes and governance models in place to meet the continually growing and evolving demands of global Third Party Risk Management regulations - you’ll also set priorities and turn them into measurable improvements.

Reporting to the Director of Third Party Risk, this is a hands-on role, with strategic scope. You’ll work across the global team, and with a variety of stakeholders throughout Monzo, to strengthen our framework, manage complex risks and improve how we deliver TPRM both tactically and strategically.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Delivering Core TPRM Operations Globally: Operating end-to-end operational activities, including supplier tiering, materiality assessments, due diligence reviews, exit planning support, and regulatory reporting.
  • Driving Operational Excellence: Taking ownership of process quality, making sure TPRM activities are completed accurately, consistently and on time. You’ll look for ways to improve how we manage third party risk in practice.
  • Helping shape our priorities: Identifying emerging risks, gaps and opportunities across third party risk management, and making recommendations to inform the team’s strategy and roadmap. You’ll develop practical solutions and help deliver improvements through to completion.

title: Offensive Security Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security

The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

  • Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing, assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.
  • Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.
  • Research novel attacks against GPU infrastructure (e.g., closed-source firmware and vendor driver binaries, device passthrough exploits, SR-IOV/IOMMU misconfigurations, RDMA/InfiniBand fabric attacks, etc.), the inference stack (e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM), and AI platform managed services (e.g., managed Slurm). Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack
  • Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.
  • Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.
  • Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation
  • Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.
  • Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.
  • Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).
  • Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.
  • Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.

Nice to have

  • Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.
  • Reverse engineering and exploits development experience
  • Application security experience
  • Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.
  • Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.
  • Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).
  • Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.

Why this role at Nebius

  • Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture

Hiring process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Security System Design interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • (Optional) Technical deep dive (90mins) to present a complex and impact project.
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:

title: Staff Engineer - Telematics
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role
At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.
The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.
This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.

What you will do

  • Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.
  • Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.
  • Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.
  • Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.
  • Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.
  • Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

About the role:

In this role, you will:

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

What you will bring

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.
  • Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.
  • Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.
  • Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.
  • Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience that could be useful
Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.


What success looks like
Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Machine Learning Engineer II, Responsible AI
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US

 About Pinterest:

 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

 The Responsible AI team is part of the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.

 At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.

 Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable skin tone , hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type .

 You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.

 What you'll do:

• execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI.

• Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.

• Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R-AI space.

• Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.

 What we're looking for:

• Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.

• Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.

• Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.

• 2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products

• Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields

• Nice to have:

• Publications at top ML conferences

• Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring

• Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration

• Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data

• Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product

 Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

 In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

title: Engineering - Internal AI Transformation
location: Canada,  Germany,  Ireland,  Italy,  Poland,  Sweden,  UK,  USA
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role / impact
As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate.

Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed.

The team / how we work
You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs.

What you'll actually be working on

  • Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n.

  • Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more

  • Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch

  • Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact

  • Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe

    What we're looking for

  • Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on

  • AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows.

  • Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers)

  • A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start

  • Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it.

  • Infra & DevOps Instincts: Hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise authentication flows

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. Specific teams may have specific location preferences.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Product Designer - Growth
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running ‘Project Heartbeat’: a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.

    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

title: Model Validation Senior Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £85,000 - £105,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐Our Model Oversight team

The second line of defence Model Oversight team (that’s us!) provides support to our colleagues in Borrowing, Fincrime & Fraud, Finance and Operations to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for a Model Validation Senior Manager - Gen AI to lead the teams’ oversight of Generative AI models/use cases (primarily built across Monzo’s Operations squads) to provide assurance that the models/use cases we use are not only good for Monzo but what's best for our customers.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

Driving the embedding of the Model Risk Framework for Generative AI use cases across Monzo

  • Lead the collaboration with the first line of defence teams to strengthen policies, standards and procedures for Generative AI model, use case, system design and build, implementation, governance, monitoring and use. Helping to embed best practice of Generative AI across the business.
  • Own the setting and maintenance of Generative AI validation methods, evidence expectations and reusable technical assets with relevant 1LoD modelling teams, applicable across all model risk areas.
  • Convert modelling/validation experience into controlled playbooks, tests and working examples that can be applied to 2LoD Validation standards and processes for all Generative AI models, use cases, systems overseen by the 2LoD Model Oversight team.
  • Coach Generative AI validation methodologies, to 2LoD Model Oversight colleagues, whom already have transferable Machine Learning skills, to reduce reliance on any single specialist for the validation of Generative AI models, use cases, systems so it can be consistently applied across Financial, Credit and Fincrime/Fraud models.

Leading the 2LoD Oversight of Operational Model Risk

  • Perform, and oversee, independent model validations of new Operational models (primarily Generative AI models, use cases, systems), and changes to existing, using proportionate modelling techniques depending on the level of complexity applied. This includes writing clear and impactful model validation reports and presenting the findings in relevant committees.
  • Build relationships with first line of defence modelling teams that develop Operational Models, and wider risk teams, to support the embedding of the model risk framework to help Monzo grow safely.
  • Review ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure Operational models are performing within risk thresholds and providing support to the relevant model development team when further action is required
  • Monitoring and measuring the overall level of Operational model risk that Monzo operates, and driving action plans with first line teams and appropriate governance forums to mitigate residual model risk within desired risk appetite.

Being a senior advocate of Model Risk Management best practices

  • Support the effective operation of the Model Risk Oversight Committee as a regular attendee, contributing to the group discussion to improve model risk management.
  • Promote and help embed a strong risk culture, making risk meaningful and relevant to everyone at Monzo. You will share best practice that is easy for everyone to understand.

🤩We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing positive impact to our customers and Monzo
  • You are self-motivated and thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • You have great attention to detail while keeping an eye on the big picture
  • You are a great communicator, able to articulate complex problems
  • You can provide effective challenge whilst building strong, respectful relationships
  • You are keen to grow your knowledge in both business and technology

And, from a technical and knowledge perspective, you should have:

  • Robust Data Science or Machine Learning background with strong Python capability
  • Experience with design of Generative AI evaluation frameworks, architectures, methods, practical tooling and platform alignment.
  • Knowledge of Gemini implementations and change assessment
  • Experience of managing a modelling project through its full lifecycle
  • If possible, some understanding of some of the following:
    • Coaching and standard setting
    • Banking MRM and regulatory context

🙌What’s in it for you

💰£85,000 - £105,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff offices, or be distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps:

- Phone call with recruiter - 30 mins
- Initial call with hiring manager - 30 mins
- Assessment & technical interview - 60 mins
- Leadership & Behavioural Interview - 60 mins

This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

#LI-TK1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

title: Pathfinder Family Support Worker
description:
Fioretti Trust is looking for two School-Based Pathfinder Workers. Each post will be based across five of our eight schools in Central and South Birmingham. The roles are fixed term and partly funded by Birmingham Pathfinder.

Working across our schools, you'll support some of our most vulnerable families and help them get the support they need. This role can make a huge, positive difference to children and their families, and it brings real value to the whole school community.

Pathfinder works through relationships first and trauma-informed practice. It's built on consistent, persistent support that helps families rebuild trust and regain a sense of control. You'll get full training from Pathfinder. As well as being part of our school teams, you'll be supported by a designated Pathfinder facilitator.

The role

  • Acting as lead professional for an allocated caseload of children and families from across your schools
  • Using assessments such as Early Help to identify needs, and leading multi-agency support plans aligned to the Pathfinder model
  • Engaging families through persistent outreach and encouraging them to take an active part in their own plans
  • Delivering evidence-based interventions, including Psychologically Informed Environments (PIE) and Non-Violent Resistance (NVR)
  • Convening case planning and review meetings, and attending case conferences under the direction of the school's Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL)
  • Keeping high-quality records on school safeguarding systems and the Eclipse case recording system

What we're looking for

We're looking for experienced Family Support Workers who are passionate about helping children and their families. You will have:

  • Experience of leading successful Early Help Plans
  • A firm knowledge of safeguarding and of the agencies that can support children and families
  • A current DSL certificate, or a commitment to obtaining one
  • The ability to build strong, trusting relationships with pupils, parents and carers
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and organisational skills
  • The confidence to manage your own caseload and working pattern
  • Good IT skills
  • A current UK driving licence (essential, because the role covers several sites)

The role may sometimes involve working outside normal school hours.

Why join us?

Fioretti Trust exists to enable every child and every adult to flourish. Every day. We can offer:

  • Thriving schools with strong outcomes
  • Trust-wide support and collaboration, working alongside experienced staff across our family of schools
  • The chance to make a real, lasting difference to children's lives and see the impact of your work every day
  • A comprehensive staff wellbeing package, reflecting our commitment to a healthy work-life balance
  • Automatic enrolment in the Local Government Pension Scheme

  • Exam Board Marking During School Hours: Exam board marking can be completed during the school day where gained time allows, and any gained time can be spent at home.

  • CPD Pathways: Rather than data-driven performance management targets, we allow staff to choose a CPD Pathway that best suits their personal development goals, including participation in NPQs.

Thank you for your interest in working with us!

 For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

 Are you looking to solve challenging engineering problems impacting Enterprise customers with 10,000+ employees? How about building a platform that contributes to mission-critical projects such as launching a rover to Mars, reducing carbon footprint by launching energy-efficient warehouses, launching critical life-saving medicines in International markets, or planning a brick-and-mortar store deployment?

 The Smartsheet Portfolio Management Pillar is looking for curious and passionate Frontend and Fullstack Software Engineers. You will help us build enterprise-grade applications within the Portfolio Collaborative Work Management space, an area that grew 4x year-over-year. Our applications manages three areas that serve our customers: A feature-rich config management tool that allows power users the ability to create their business processes; A fast and reliable orchestration engine that runs millions of distributed transactions per day; A global management service that alters the attributes of Project assets and ensures the state of the Portfolio is running and updates are managed at-scale.

 Our Engineering team members are passionate about working on multiple projects using several technologies. We are a self-operating service team and use a diverse set of Frontend (JavaScript, TypeScript, React), Backend (Ruby/Java), and Cloud-native services(AWS).

 In 2005, Smartsheet was founded on the idea that teams and millions of people worldwide deserve a better way to deliver their very best work. title: Engineering Manager, Ads Product Catalogs
description:
Headquarters: Remote - The Netherlands

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.

 Reddit is where people come to discover, research, and discuss products that inform their purchasing decisions. Shopping, across advertising and organic experiences, is a high priority for the company, and product catalogs are foundational to that work.

 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Reddit’s Product Catalogs team. You will lead a full-stack engineering team responsible for the infrastructure and advertiser-facing experiences that help thousands of advertisers onboard, organize, and manage millions of products. Your team will build intuitive UIs, robust APIs, and scalable backend systems for catalog ingestion, storage, and product data management.

 These systems power Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) and organic shopping, connecting users with relevant products in the context of their interests and conversations. Someone browsing r/golf might discover popular golf clubs, while someone reading a discussion about sunglasses in r/BuyItForLife might see the exact models being discussed. Your team will make it easier for advertisers to bring their products to Reddit and participate in these moments of discovery.

 In this role, you will set technical direction, develop engineers, and drive execution across the catalog platform and advertiser experience. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to understand customer needs and make catalog onboarding and management seamless. You will also partner with Reddit’s Knowledge Graph teams to support organic shopping experiences.

 This role calls for strong technical judgment, people leadership, and a focus on customer needs. It is based in Reddit’s Amsterdam or London office, with a team working across European time zones.

 Responsibilities:

• Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products

• Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences

• Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads

• Establish and manage to SLAs within your team

• Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team

• Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

 Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development

• 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams

• You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.

• Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.

• Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

 Benefits:

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Private Pension plan with Employer-matching

• 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan

• Income Replacement Programs

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
